non_news_filter.rule: Fixed before scanning: drop a row if its title matches the case-insensitive wrap regex, or title plus Stock_symbol contain at least 3 distinct literal uppercase tickers from the existing SEC ticker map and cached filing display-name tickers. No row-by-row review.

note: 8-K item codes are anchors for sampling, not labels. Headline text still gets labelled blind. The labeller reads to_label.csv only, never anchors.csv or this manifest. This is a separate supplementary credit set, not E24 or a tuning set.
rule: 8-K filings 2010-01-01 through 2020-06-30; client-side exact item recheck; local FNSPID headline dated filing-2 through filing+5 days, inclusive; normalized issuer name without legal suffixes or literal uppercase ticker in text; unique normalized headline, earliest matching date; standard E25 leak exclusions plus R3, credit held-out, pool and extra; seeded hash draw, at most 150 headlines/item
